title: Sealed Justin Jefferson Jettas Mix Cereal 2025 Limited-Edition Minnesota Vikings
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Fan Apparel & Souvenirs:Football-NFL
descriptionText: The product is a limited-edition Justin Jefferson Jetta's Mix cereal featuring the Minnesota Vikings wide receiver. Produced by General Mills, this collectible item is inspired by the National Football League (NFL) and is designed in black color to represent the team. Made in the United States, this cereal is a must-have for fans of both football and the Minnesota Vikings, adding a unique twist to their favorite sport.
